Subject: Discovery recap + MAP / next steps (Brightware)

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Brightware’s use case and priorities. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps: 

1) Summary of need
- You’re primarily looking to improve customer-facing search relevance across document types and reduce inference cost per query for the enterprise plan.
- Current traffic pattern: ~250 qps peak for search API, lots of short queries (~50–150 tokens).

2) How Redwood fits
- Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput + autoscaling policies to handle peak bursts.
- KV/prefix caching and batching should reduce per-query tokens and cost without impacting latency SLOs.

3) Proposed immediate next steps
- I attached a 1-page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for a 6-week pilot and roles/responsibilities (mutual_action_plan_Brightware_v1.pdf).
- Pricing tiers attached (redwood_pricing_tiers.xlsx) and a rough cost estimate scoped to the traffic you shared.
- Dev to run a quick architecture review (Dev Patel) and confirm any integration blockers.

4) Asks from Brightware
- Confirm pilot priority and target completion date (we recommended Feb 28).
- Share a sample (anonymized) traffic dump for profiling (optional).

If that all looks right, can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week? I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
